reply_text:
*Found one ship-blocking issue* in `billing-anniversary` against `main`.

*CRITICAL — Renewal dates use the wrong month’s length*
`src/schedule.js:6–7` clamps the anchor against the *source* month, then constructs a date in the *next* month. This can skip February entirely or renew before the intended anniversary:

• Jan 31, 2026, anchor 31 → *Mar 3*, expected Feb 28.
• Jan 31, 2028, anchor 31 → *Mar 2*, expected Feb 29.
• Feb 28, 2026, anchor 31 → *Mar 28*, expected Mar 31.
• Apr 30, 2026, anchor 31 → *May 30*, expected May 31.

*Recommended fix:* determine the target month first, then clamp the original anchor against that month’s length. Add regression tests for shorter-month transitions, leap February, and returning to the original anchor afterward.

*Verification:* All 5 existing tests pass, but the two tests in `test/schedule.test.js` miss these transitions. An independent check across every month and anchor for 2024–2028 found 66 incorrect results.

No additional findings. No files changed.
